schema.title: Standardized Trigger Contract
schema.description: Self-contained HTTP trigger schema for Get_All_Data_Matrix. Includes the standard shared trigger fields and the flow-specific odataFilter field.

id.description: Primary identifier associated with the request.

device.description: Device information related to the request.

odataFilter.description: SharePoint OData filter expression used to build a Get items filter query, for example: Status eq 'Open' and Category eq 'Finance'.

schema.x-compatibility-note: Shared and flow-specific trigger fields are fully built into this single schema without external references.

Compose_HTTP_Request_URL_2.inputs: https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/mailFolders/Inbox/messages?$select=subject,from,receivedDateTime,bodyPreview,body,toRecipients,ccRecipients,bccRecipients,hasAttachments,importance,webLink&$filter=isRead eq false AND receivedDateTime ge @{startOfDay(utcNow())} AND receivedDateTime lt @{addDays(startOfDay(utcNow()), 1)}&$top=1000
